description: This Java class defines 'SubjectDnCredentials', a helper class for generating authentication IDs based on X.509 certificate subject distinguished names (DN). It provides static factory methods to create credentials objects for a given tenant ID and subject DN, encapsulating the extraction and formatting of the subject DN from an X500Principal. The class extends 'AbstractDeviceCredentials' and overrides 'getType()' to specify the credentials type as X.509 certificates.

classes.name: SubjectDnCredentials
classes.description: A credentials class that encapsulates the subject DN of an X.509 certificate for device authentication purposes, providing static factory methods and overriding the credential type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the credential type string indicating an X.509 certificate.
